page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-32 is an arm64-based virtual machine instance belonging to the c4a server family. It is configured with 32 dedicated virtual CPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The underlying ARM architecture provides a power-efficient foundation for executing multi-threaded applications that require substantial memory capacity.

This server configuration does not include local NVMe storage or bundled local disks, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. There are no graphics processing units integrated into this instance, and it does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The instance relies entirely on its dedicated CPU allocation and memory capacity to drive workloads.

Operating on an ARM-based architecture, the c4a-highmem-32 offers a cost-efficient profile for memory-intensive workloads by leveraging the resource density of the ARM platform. The high memory-to-core ratio makes it suitable for workloads such as in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise applications, and memory-bound data processing tasks that do not require local SSD storage or hardware acceleration.
